summary: Fully refurbished throughout, this well-presented home offers modern and spacious accommodation in a popular residential location close to local amenities, schools and transport links. The property benefits from a contemporary kitchen, modern bathroom, fresh décor, new flooring, gas central heating, double glazing, off-road parking and a private enclosed garden. Ideal for families and professionals seeking a move-in-ready home.
description: A beautifully refurbished home finished to a high standard throughout, offering stylish and well-proportioned accommodation in a popular residential area of Northallerton. Recently updated with fresh neutral décor, new flooring and modern fixtures and fittings, the property provides a bright and welcoming living environment ready for immediate occupation. The accommodation includes a spacious living area, contemporary fitted kitchen, well-sized bedrooms and a modern bathroom suite. Further benefits include gas central heating, double glazing, off-road parking and a private enclosed rear garden, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Conveniently situated close to local amenities, schools and transport links, this attractive home is perfectly suited to professionals, couples and families alike. Early viewing is highly recommended.
